messages:
Anya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we want to pilot a "Kudos Kiosk" (vending-style snack station) in the SF and NY lobbies next month. Goal: small, on-the-spot recognition reward for spot-award redemptions and peer kudos. Looking for feasibility + rough budget. Thoughts? :eyes:
Mike (Facilities): Cool idea. Do we have space / power? Typical vending needs a 2ft clearance, 110V outlet, and a floor anchor. Also who will restock?
Leo (Vendor Ops): We chatted with two vendors: SnackJoy (basic snack cans, credit-card enabled) and KudosBox (token/QR based, integrates with single-use QR tokens). KudosBox can push QR generation for each redemption. Lead time ~3 weeks for unit + setup.
Jenna (People Ops): For tokens: we can either send single-use QR codes to winners (Slack DM) or give physical token credit via kiosk. Slack DM + QR seems easiest for remote folks too. I can draft 3 QR card designs for approval.
Sarah (Finance): Ballpark: $4k-$6k for a 2-site pilot (units + initial snacks + shipping). Need vendor invoices and a PO to sign. Also confirm gift policy: must keep per-person gift <$50 to avoid taxable fringe.
Mike (Facilities): Also need allergen labels on each slot (peanuts, dairy, gluten). Can vendor provide customizable product lists per city? SF team prefers more vegan options.
Anya (People Ops): Draft rollout schedule (super short):
```
Week of May 9: install SF unit (Lobby A)
Week of May 16: install NY unit (Main lobby)
Week of May 23: soft-launch + token campaign (internal email + #general post)
```
We'd like a 6-week pilot.
Leo (Vendor Ops): KudosBox supports per-slot labels and can upload a CSV for menu per site. I can get sample menu and nutrition sheet. They also offer a 30-min training for facilities on restocking and ticket clearing.
Jenna (People Ops): Volunteer ask: need 2 folks/week/site to help restock first month and a team to write small "Congrats" cards (150 pcs). I'll post a sign-up form. Anyone want to own the volunteer schedule? :raising_hand:
Sarah (Finance): Approve concept pending PO and vendor contract terms. Also need a breakdown: unit cost, monthly refresh, estimated token redemption rate (we should cap redemptions to control spend).
Mike (Facilities): I can be onsite lead for SF. Need delivery window + vendor contact. Also recommend a small lockbox for token remainders.
Anya (People Ops): Thanks — @Leo can you get two vendor quotes + sample menus by EOD Thursday? @Sarah I'll send an initial budget sheet. @Jenna please draft the volunteer sign-up. Legal review may be needed for T&Cs on tokens.
Leo (Vendor Ops): Yep — will send quotes + sample CSV menus by Thursday. Also can demo KudosBox admin UI in 20 min if helpful.
Jenna (People Ops): Volunteer sign-up draft: 1) restock shifts, 2) card-writing party (in-person + remote template). I'll share the link soon. Re: cards — we can include a tiny sticker that says "Redeemed with kudos".
Sarah (Finance): I'll prepare PO template. Also: propose a soft cap of $1,000 total redemptions per site for the pilot (we can revisit).
Mike (Facilities): Noted. I'll check outlet availability and floor anchoring on Monday.
Anya (People Ops): Awesome — sounds like momentum. If legal or facilities have blockers call it out here. Otherwise greenlight contingent on quotes/PO/labels. :party_parrot:
deploy-bot: Vendor quote from KudosBox uploaded to shared drive: https://drive.internal/kudosbox/quote_1916004321.pdf
Anya (People Ops): Perfect — will review and follow up. Thanks everyone!
